concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-client-side-authentication-migrate-from-origin-key-to-client-key]] — dated Web/iOS/Android origin- or public-key to client-key migration guide with version thresholds, credential and allowed-origin setup, environment scope, and old-key coexistence (2026-09-15 snapshot; raw last modified 2020).
warnings: This is a 2020-modified migration guide; its SDK thresholds are scoped to the listed products and versions.
Generating a client key leaves pre-existing origin/public keys valid in this guide; this is distinct from rotating an existing client key.
